items.html: And when the seven lights ascended above, the vessels that had descended in Beria also ascended above, into Atzilut, but they did not join together. And just as the seven lights were in the aspect of Ibbur — three included within three, with the point of Malchut being seventh to them in the secret of “a step outward” — so too were the vessels in this same manner: three included within three, with Malchut among them.
